rationale: CPRI has gapped up ~10.5% on no news catalyst and is currently printing at the absolute high of the session with only 2 candles of data, making it impossible to assess whether this is a sustainable breakout or an exhaustion top. The 5-minute ATR of $0.073 is extremely tight relative to the $0.43 bid-ask spread context and the magnitude of the move, suggesting the price action data may be incomplete or the instrument is thinly traded intraday; combined with a broad market under pressure (SPY -1.09%, VIXY +5.73%), chasing a gap-and-run long at the high carries excessive fade risk, while shorting a stock with this kind of momentum and no clear reversal signal is equally dangerous.
